card.statement: If $M\to N$ is an arrow in the closure graph $G_2$, then the *congruence class $C_M$ of $M$ is contained in the closure of the *congruence class $C_N$ of $N$, and so the codimension of $C_M$ is greater than the codimension of $C_N$.
card.label: Lemma 3

paper.title: Change of the *congruence canonical form of 2-by-2 matrices under perturbations
paper.abstract: We study how small perturbations of a 2-by-2 complex matrix can change its canonical form for *congruence. We construct the Hasse diagram for the closure ordering on the set of *congruence classes of 2-by-2 matrices.
